content.comment_body: I recently obtained the new [company_name] [product_name]. It seems to combine features from previous [product_name] modules. It includes a 4-port switch similar to one model, plus an interface and cellular connection from another, though it lacks certain digital I/Os but offers a Modbus RTU interface. Documentation does not clarify whether email sending is supported. After years of waiting for a North American version of the previous [product_name], this module arrives without a cellular engine, allowing installation for regional compatibility. See Product note Entry ID: [article_no], Entry date: [article_no]. I have installed the cellular engine, antennas, and SIM card; status lights are normal, but I cannot connect a computer to the module's web server. I plan to post further questions on this topic. If connectivity issues are resolved, this module could be highly beneficial for North America and suitable for regions where previous modules function. Split from thread on discontinued 3G service and looking for 4G-compatible replacements.

This thread was closed because the question was posted twice. The duplicate topic 'Can't connect to [product_name]' appears in the '[product_name] - Communication' conference. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces challenges connecting their computer to the web server of a newly installed [product_name], despite all hardware components showing proper installation based on status indicators. The lack of connectivity introduces doubts about practical use, while the user highlights regional needs and a desire for solutions similar to older [company_name] products.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects easy connectivity between their computer and the [product_name] web server once the required hardware is installed. They anticipate access to functionalities familiar from previous modules, together with clear and dependable documentation facilitating regional setup.
